_comment: AUTHORITATIVE metadata for the Zenodo record. Read this before editing:
1. If BOTH .zenodo.json and CITATION.cff exist, the Zenodo agent uses this
file and IGNORES CITATION.cff COMPLETELY. CITATION.cff is still worth
keeping — GitHub renders its 'Cite this repository' button from it — but
the two must be kept in step by hand, because Zenodo will not read it.
2. NO 'license' KEY HERE ON PURPOSE. Zenodo reads the LICENSE file in the
repository root and generates the licence metadata from it (overriding
its CC-BY-4.0 default). Declaring it in both places invites them to
disagree. Set the licence ONCE, in LICENSE.
3. Only put information here that stays CONSISTENT ACROSS RELEASES.
Version comes from the git tag, not from this file.

title: GroMax GUI: a desktop interface for comparative GROMACS trajectory analysis
description:
A desktop GUI for GROMACS trajectory analysis. Scans folders of simulations, auto-pairs replicas, runs analyses (RMSD, RMSF, radius of gyration, SASA, hydrogen bonds, minimum distance, 2D-RMSD, DSSP secondary structure and shared-basis PCA) across experimental conditions, and compares results in interactive, publication-styled plots.

Includes multi-chain system mapping so residues can be selected by biological identity (chain + full-length residue number) rather than GROMACS' flat internal numbering, and shared-basis PCA so principal components are directly comparable between conditions.
